descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Welcome to GO CLUBBING™

**The next-generation social music platform for Meta Quest.**

Experience live DJs, immersive virtual venues, Meta Avatars and real-time social experiences designed for music lovers around the world.

Whether you're attending a live DJ set, meeting friends, discovering new artists or exploring incredible virtual worlds, GO CLUBBING brings live entertainment into virtual reality like never before.

## Features

- Live DJ performances
- Full Meta Avatars with voice chat
- ClubMixed Live streaming integration
- Twin-screen live entertainment
- Global multiplayer community
- Dynamic lighting and immersive visual effects
- Beautiful virtual venues
- Built for electronic music fans, DJs, artists and labels

## Explore Amazing Venues

- The Underground
- Pool Party
- Mars Sphere
- Sunset Bar
- The Time Machine
- And many more coming soon

## Constantly Evolving

We're continually adding:

- New venues
- Live events
- Creator broadcasts
- Enhanced avatars
- Improved networking
- Better performance
- Community features

Join thousands of music fans helping build the future of live entertainment.

## Coming Soon

- 🚀 ClubMixed Live integration
- 🎤 Live creator broadcasts
- 🏟️ New immersive venues
- 🎉 Private parties
- 🎶 Record label events
- 🎥 Live mobile streaming into VR
- 🌍 Community events
